basis.scope: Historical isolated-provider audit is not a universal host capability inventory; later qualifications must establish exact scientific deployment pins.

availability_at_freeze.cpu_only_fixed_action_runner: required; must be runnable without network or a paid service
availability_at_freeze.model_weights_or_provider_credentials: No scientific model deployment is qualified/pinned by LA-003. The supervisor provider session is not itself experiment qualification. Model study is planned but currently not dispatchable.
availability_at_freeze.qualified_solver_or_checker: Not qualified by this protocol. Host binaries may exist; only actual LA-010 deployment/checker evidence admits a scored proof-dependent arm.
availability_at_freeze.live_ucan_crypto: Not yet qualified; real verifier is required for scored A3/A4. Fixture-only envelope checks cannot substitute.
availability_at_freeze.durable_consumption_store: Not yet qualified; actual LA-012 durability qualification is required for scored A4. Process-local memory cannot substitute.
availability_at_freeze.source_manifests_and_independent_oracles: not yet frozen; execution is blocked until LA-004 and later independent-label tasks provide them

per_attempt_resource_group.scope: One contained process group/resource cgroup per attempt, including benchmark runner, handler, effect observer and every solver/checker descendant. Outer watchdog/controller costs are separately measured and included in full cost reporting.
per_attempt_resource_group.cpu_affinity_rule: Reserve one logical CPU from the host allowed cpuset before starting the attempt and enforce that singleton cpuset for every descendant. Record its CPU ID and effective cpuset/quota; inherited affinity alone is not accepted if descendants can widen it.
per_attempt_resource_group.solver_thread_rule: Pass each selected solver/checker its documented single-thread option when supported and retain exact argv/configuration; qualify the effective behavior. Environment settings are supplementary, not the sole CPU enforcement.
per_attempt_resource_group.accounting: Use group-wide CPU user+system counters for all current/exited descendants and aggregate memory peak; wall time starts before worker launch and ends when the entire group is gone. Do not sum per-process memory limits or substitute wall time for measured CPU.
per_attempt_resource_group.termination: A qualified outer watchdog stops the entire group at the first wall/CPU/memory/process-limit or global-budget event and waits for all descendants to exit. Retain stop-request time, group-empty time, exit/signal, CPU usage, memory peak and reason.
per_attempt_resource_group.enforcement_overshoot: The stated thresholds are requested stopping budgets. Record actual CPU/wall usage and termination latency, including any overshoot; flag the violation and include all usage in cost totals. Never truncate measured cost to the configured limit.
per_attempt_resource_group.qualification_gate: LA-008/LA-014 must demonstrate descendant containment, singleton CPU enforcement, process/thread ceiling, aggregate memory accounting and whole-group timeout/cleanup using bounded stress probes before scored attempts. If controls cannot be enforced, no scored attempt is admitted.

fixed_action_budget.stop_rule: Charge actual group CPU including cleanup/overshoot after every attempt. Do not start a further20-second attempt unless at least20CPU-seconds remain in the global budget; stop immediately on a budget violation and report all not-started units.
fixed_action_budget.meaning: The five-hour figure is the fixed-action group CPU stopping budget and nominal sum of90020-second per-attempt thresholds, not a measured CPU total or guaranteed full-job wall duration. Setup, qualification, watchdog/controller overhead and termination overrun are measured separately and retained in full paper cost.

reproducibility_requirements: immutable source, policy, handler, retrieval, and environment hashes
command, seed, configuration fingerprint, exit status, elapsed time, and raw outcome for every attempt
no user-profile toolchain or network-dependent installation in validation
effective CPU cpuset/quota, selected CPU ID, tool thread settings and process/thread ceiling
whole-group CPU user+system counters, aggregate memory peak, stop-request/group-empty times and any enforcement overshoot
separately measured setup, qualification and external watchdog/controller overhead

closed_loop_agent: accessible model identifier and immutable weights or provider revision
Freeze exact30 family/60 case lineage-disjoint model-study cohort and deterministic quotas before outputs
Implement actual A0–A4 model interventions and retain full proposed actions/replans
Do not infer model prompt/retrieval efficacy from model-free fixed-action controls
solver_or_checker_claim: digest-bound deployment usable under the authoritative PATH
raw solver result and independent checker receipt
live_ucan_or_durable_replay_claim: real verifier/key material handling without secret disclosure

decision: LA-003 completes protocol definition only. Both declared studies remain unrun until their own real source/oracle/mechanism/model qualifications are satisfied. Retain every LA-004–LA-025 paper obligation. No paid access or fixture substitution is assumed.

host_capacity_observation.observer_context: Host staging agent; scheduler reservation and attempt cgroup enforcement are not qualified by this observation.
host_capacity_observation.interpretation: The proposed one-core/2GiB attempt fits the observed host capacity. Shared scheduler reservation, actual toolchain availability and enforced per-attempt controls remain prerequisite qualification work.
